Implement single-source shortest paths in a directed nonnegative weighted graph in C++17.
Input starts with t. Each case contains n m s, followed by m edges u v w.
Vertices are 1-based, 1 <= s <= n. Self loops and parallel edges are permitted.
Weights satisfy 0 <= w <= 10^12. Sum of n + m across cases is at most 200000.
Output n integers in vertex order per case: shortest distance from s, or -1 if unreachable.
Use 64-bit distances and a priority-queue Dijkstra implementation with O((n+m) log n) time.
Produce solution.cpp, a correctness argument, complexity, and executable boundary/random tests.
Sample input:
1
4 4 1
1 2 5
1 3 1
3 2 1
2 4 2
Sample output:
0 2 1 4
